admission.justification: The bundled hash-pinned catalog, isolated lazy AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE with read/write asymmetry, local-only languages.json and custom library overrides, active LanguageSet cache-key isolation, declarative tags.scm/tests.scm extraction, and .lean reservation together guarantee uniform language-agnostic anchor resolution across every production consumer without privileged grammar dependencies or cross-set cache leakage.

guarantee: Every tree-sitter citation consumer resolves source bindings and JS/TS test-case call sites declaratively through the active or repository-scoped LanguageSet ContextVar backed by the bundled hash-pinned language_catalog.lock.json, isolated lazy AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE wheel loading, and local-only languages.json/custom-library overrides, derives extractor identity from pinned versions, binaries, and query digests across all downstream caches, preserves read-degrade versus write-refuse failure asymmetry, and keeps .lean permanently reserved for the built-in Lean declaration scanner.
title: Uniform language catalog, lazy cache, and declarative LanguageSet seam
